user_facing_explanation: Number one should sit at the top of the overalls, with the rest stepping down the board. There is still no validated Gridiron Standard OVR calculator (OVR is supposed to come from an attribute build), so these are editorial display overalls aligned to the audited orders — not new locked cards and not an EA formula. QB order stays Burrow, Purdy, Allen, Lamar (flagged), Maye, Dak, Goff, Lawrence, Stroud, Love. RB keeps Warren at number one on 2026 EPA/RYOE/receiving, with one evidence swap (Hubbard over Kyren); Achane stays in on ability with availability/sample flags. Historical card overalls are superseded only as display values pending a real attribute re-score.
